description: This file defines the 'SettingsScreen' widget for a Flutter application, allowing users to modify theme settings and view networking debug info. It also contains the internal '_NetworkDebugCard' widget for network status monitoring.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays app settings, including theme selection and network debug information.

classes.name: _NetworkDebugCard
classes.description: A stateful widget providing network connection status, profile fetching, and WebSocket interaction for debugging purposes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the SettingsScreen widget tree, including theme options and a network debug card.

methods.name: _NetworkDebugCardState.initState
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket message listener to update the UI on received messages.

methods.name: _NetworkDebugCardState.build
methods.description: Builds the network debug UI, including status updates, profile fetch button, WebSocket connect and ping buttons.
